entities.summary: Leader of Bosnia and Herzegovina (1992–1996 (Republika Srpska)). SDS; wartime Serb leader; psychiatrist/poet; ordered Srebrenica genocide; fugitive 13 years (disguised as healer); convicted genocide/war crimes (life imprisonment, ICTY/IRMCT)
